answer: Sybil tax: every identity pays a sunk, non-refundable 50-credit fee to dock at the jetty before trading. One honest agent pays 50 once and trades for 30 epochs. A farmer minting 1,000 fake islands pays 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 credits, while those clones could steal only a few hundred over that horizon. When a gale of cheap compute arrives, the fee cannot be borrowed or refunded. Clones stay underwater; honest agents keep their full yield.
